C0395.title: Two Men Illegally Obtained Over 3 Million Personal Records to Farm and Sell Accounts in 'Love and Deepspace'
C0395.summary: Lin and Xie illegally acquired more than 3 million pieces of citizens' personal information, developed automated scripts for the game 'Love and Deepspace', batch-registered and real-name verified game accounts, used scripts to auto-login, check in, and complete daily tasks to farm the accounts, then sold them through online stores, making over 1.6 million yuan in profit.
